notes.title: KAZ v0.1.8
notes.content:
Kaz Update v0.1.8 – More Items, More Chaos, and the New Curse Meter!
Hey speedsters!

This week, we’ve got some spicy new updates that are about to turn your runs upside-down. The biggest? We’ve dropped a whole new batch of items into the game. That’s right—your builds are about to get wilder, crazier, and a lot more unpredictable. Whether you’re chasing the perfect synergy or just trying to break your old high score, there’s never been a better time to experiment (and brag about it).

But wait, there’s more—let’s talk about CURSES.
The Curse Meter: Feel the Pressure
We heard you. The old “get a penalty every 3 rounds” system? Gone. Say hello to the Curse Meter.

How does it work? Every match, your Curse Meter creeps up, just a little.

Some enemies—especially those nasty traps—will spike your curse way faster if you’re not careful.

Fill the meter, and… let’s just say you’ll regret it.

Now, instead of waiting for a random malus every few rounds, you can see the pressure building up, match after match. It’s tense. It’s stressful. It’s exactly what Kaz needed.
Why did we do this?
We wanted curses to feel like a real threat, not just a surprise slap every once in a while. The new system rewards careful play, and it makes those clutch dodges and big risk moves even more satisfying.

And with all the new items? Trust us, the combos (and disasters) are going to get wild.
[hr][/hr]
That’s all for now! Jump in, try to break the game, and let us know what you think on Discord or tag us on socials. Your feedback helps us keep Kaz immediate, intense, and just the right amount of evil.

And remember:
If you lose, it’s definitely because of the Curse Meter. We all know it. 😉

Stay fast, stay cursed!

— Kalinarm
